_comment: Per-issuer mapping contract: how to normalize one trustee/issuer's reference tape into the canonical registry schema (canonical-registry-schema.md). Copy per issuer; fill the column names from that issuer's actual report. The adapter (scripts/srt-registry-inputs/normalize_tape.py) is mapping-driven, so a new issuer = a new mapping file, no code change.

source._registry_sheet: Sheet/tab holding the obligor-level reference portfolio (ignored for csv)
source._header_row: 1-based row index of the column headers

column_map._comment: canonical_field : exact source column header. Omit a line if the issuer doesn't provide that field.

transforms._comment: Explicit unit handling. The adapter converts per these flags; it never infers.
transforms._pd_scale: 1.0 if PD is already decimal; 0.01 if reported as a percent number (e.g. 1.2 meaning 1.2%)
transforms._recovery_scale: 1.0 if recovery is decimal; 0.01 if percent
transforms._rona_scale: 1.0 if RONA is already in base units; e.g. 1000000 if reported in millions and you want absolute
transforms._date_formats: Tried in order to parse maturity_date into ISO; first match wins
transforms._rating_bucket_map: Maps the leading rating token (AAA.. or notch like BB-) to a canonical bucket

status_rules._defaulted_values: Status cell values that mark a row as defaulted (excluded from the performing-pool weighting)

deal_meta._stated_reference_notional: The tie-out target. From the trustee Capital Structure / Notes Information tab, or keyed at intake.

tie_out._count_defaulted_in_total: Whether defaulted rows count toward SUM(rona) for the stated-notional tie-out
tie_out._tolerance_pct: Allowed |SUM(rona)-stated|/stated before it is a STOP (0.005 = 0.5%)
